scale_note: Render at 640x360 and upscale by an integer (2x=1280x720, 3x=1920x1080) with nearest-neighbour. All PNGs hard alpha (0/255).
coordinate_convention: x right, y down, origin top-left of each image/frame. Anchors are in frame-local pixels.
player_car_size_decision: In-game Fade car is ~161 px wide (car_fade/, 172x97 canvas) = one-step BOX downscale of the approved side fullres masters (same method/palette as cars/fade/side). The 343x193 originals in cars/fade/side/ are unchanged and listed too (use them only for a 2x zoom / cutscene; never scale them by a non-integer).

parallax.draw_order: a (back) -> b -> c -> d -> collision layer (1.0) -> gameplay sprites -> UI

layers.desc: smoggy sky: dark grey-brown top -> dusty orange horizon, opaque
far skyline, orange smog haze stronger lower down
mid slum towers, orange smog haze
near coloured shacks/wires (decor only, no collision)

collision_layer.desc: Nearest layer = flat black silhouettes = everything the car can hit. tag "solid" = crash (damage, bounce/stop); tag "breakable" = car smashes through (play break sheet, spawn black shards + spark, small damage).
collision_layer.coords: polygons and bbox are piece-local pixels (origin top-left of the PNG); approxPolyDP eps 1.2 px; use bbox for cheap broad-phase

break.note: chunks fly apart + fall; play once after smashed, then spawn explosion/debris

explosion.note: frames centred on burst centroid; play once

debris.note: particles: random velocity, gravity ~0.25 px/frame^2, spin by swapping/flipping

select_screen.why: Authored at the native pixel density of the approved 1280x720 originals: Fade/Seek are NOT resampled (integer pixel shifts only), car layers at 1.0 scale, logo = approved 298x78 sprite x2 nearest. Gameplay stays 640x360.

sizing.note: Fade at native size is 84% of 720 (90% would need a ~1200x675 canvas, which is not a clean 16:9 multiple of 640x360). Car is native 1.0 = 88% of width (>=70%).

car_layer_order.note: body -> rear_engine -> front_gear reproduces the approved front34 composite pixel-exactly; rear_engine -> body -> front_gear (as requested) hides part of the engine pod behind the wheel arch. Either works since they are separate layers.

layout.note: select screen is authored at 1280x720 = native pixel density of the approved originals (2x the 640x360 gameplay view)

fade_group.rule: figure centred on span front-axle..door-front-edge; grille/headlights (x<=493) unblocked

seek_group.rule: figure centred on span front-axle(near hook)..door-front-edge of Seek's Trans Am (layer x 637..818 -> screen ~731)

carousel.note: the car bob only moves car layers; character frames are positioned independently so the bob never moves Fade/Seek
